Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Verified the failure** — checked service status and deployment history; confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** in all production regions.
3. **Verified recovery** — post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0002) describing the failure and the rollback; this also paged the on-call engineer. Note: the first incident-creation attempt timed out, but I verified via the incident list that it hadn't been created before retrying, so there was no duplicate page.

**Follow-up needed:** The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown — that investigation is captured in the incident.
